WITH

tourist_attractions_visitors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t."id", t."name" AS tourist_name
    FROM "tourists" t
    JOIN "visitors" v ON t."id" = v."visitorid"
    JOIN "visitrecords" vr ON v."id" = vr."visitorid"
    JOIN "locations" l ON t."location" = l."locationname"
    WHERE l."locationname" = 'Portobello'
      AND vr."touristattractionid" IS NOT NULL
),


local_markets_visitors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t."id", t."name" AS tourist_name
    FROM "tourists" t
    JOIN "visitors" v ON t."id" = v."visitorid"
    JOIN "visitrecords" vr ON v."id" = vr."visitorid"
    JOIN "markets" m ON vr."localmarketid" = m."id"
    JOIN "locations" l ON m."location" = l."locationname"
    WHERE l."locationname" = 'Portobello'
      AND vr."localmarketid" IS NOT NULL
)


SELECT
    ta.tourist_name AS tourist_visited_attractions,
    lm.tourist_name AS tourist_visited_markets
FROM tourist_attractions_visitors ta
FULL OUTER JOIN local_markets_visitors lm ON ta."id" = lm."id"
ORDER BY COALESCE(ta.tourist_name, lm.tourist_name);

SELECT DISTINCT t."id", t."name"
FROM "tourists" t
JOIN "visitors" v ON t."id" = v."visitorid"
JOIN "visitrecords" vr ON v."id" = vr."visitorid"
WHERE
    
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM "visitrecords" vr_ta
        WHERE vr_ta."visitorid" = v."id"
        AND vr_ta."touristattractionid" IS NOT NULL
    )
    AND
    
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM "visitrecords" vr_lm
        JOIN "markets" m ON vr_lm."localmarketid" = m."id"
        JOIN "locations" l ON m."location" = l."locationname"
        WHERE vr_lm."visitorid" = v."id"
        AND vr_lm."localmarketid" IS NOT NULL
        AND LOWER(l."locationname") = LOWER('Portobello')
    );

WITH responsibility_counts AS (
    SELECT
        r."responsibility",
        COUNT(DISTINCT ir."internshipid") AS internship_count
    FROM
        "responsibilities" r
    JOIN
        "internships_responsibilities" ir ON r."id" = ir."responsibilityid"
    GROUP BY
        r."responsibility"
),
total_internships AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT "id") AS total
    FROM
        "internships"
)
SELECT
    rc."responsibility"
FROM
    responsibility_counts rc
CROSS JOIN
    total_internships ti
WHERE
    rc.internship_count = ti.total;

WITH geologist_specimen_types AS (
    SELECT
        gs."geologistid",
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT gs."specimentype") AS specimen_types
    FROM
        "geologists_specimens" gs
    GROUP BY
        gs."geologistid"
),
common_specimens AS (
    SELECT
        UNNEST(specimen_types) AS specimen_type,
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_geologists,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY UNNEST(specimen_types)) AS type_count
    FROM
        geologist_specimen_types
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    "specimen_type"
FROM
    common_specimens
WHERE
    type_count = total_geologists
ORDER BY
    "specimen_type";
